title: Ready, episode 5: the phone in the bedroom

beats.source: The rule every Mumsnet thread lands on

beats.line: Her first phone. Where does it sleep?

beats.me: She gets her first phone next month. Where should it charge?
digi: Agree where devices sleep before the phone arrives, not after.
Write it into your family deal together, and you both sign it.

beats.line: Phone charges outside the bedroom first.
Her phone charges in the kitchen. Her call.
